```{r}
library(mclust)

r <- 3; p <- 5
simulate_group <- function(n, mean_matrix, row_sd = 0.5, col_sd = 0.5) {
	row_cov <- diag(row_sd, nrow(mean_matrix))
	col_cov <- diag(col_sd, ncol(mean_matrix))
	lapply(seq_len(n), function(i) mean_matrix + row_cov %*% matrix(rnorm(r * p), r, p) %*% col_cov)
}

M1 <- matrix(1, r, p)
M2 <- matrix(-1, r, p)
x_list <- c(simulate_group(80, M1), simulate_group(40, M2))

contam <- lapply(seq_len(15), function(i) matrix(runif(r*p, -1, 1), r, p))
x_list <- c(x_list, contam)
```

```{r}
set.seed(NULL)
rimle_fit(x_list, g = 2, k = 5.623413e-20, init = "hennig-coretto", verbose = TRUE)

rimle_fit(x_list, g = 2, k = 5.623413e-20, init = "kmeans", verbose = TRUE)

rimle_fit(x_list, g = 2, estimate_k = TRUE, init = "hennig-coretto", verbose = TRUE, use_parallel = TRUE, n_cores = 4)
```
